name: Example Skill Plugin
description: Reference plugin showing how to declare and register a skill.

skills.name: example-greet
skills.description: Prints a friendly greeting. Use to verify the skill plugin is loaded.
skills.description.zh-CN: 打印一句友好问候。用于验证 skill 插件是否加载成功。
skills.instructions: When invoked, respond with: 'Hello, {argument}! This skill was loaded from the example-skill-plugin.'

skills.name: example-ping
skills.description: Responds with 'pong'. A minimal smoke-test skill.
skills.description.zh-CN: 回复 'pong'。一个最小的冒烟测试 skill。
skills.instructions: Reply with exactly: 'pong' (no markdown, no extra text).
